title: Christmas Word Search
subtitle: Large Print: 60 Merry Puzzles for Adults & Seniors
author: Hollow Pine Puzzles
description:
Cozy puzzles for the holidays.

Pour a mug of cocoa and settle in by the tree with 60 large print word search puzzles full of Christmas cheer. From cookies and carols to sleigh rides, stockings and the twelve days of Christmas, every puzzle celebrates the most wonderful time of the year.

Inside you'll find:

  • 60 themed puzzles: holiday baking, carols, decorations, the nativity, winter fun and more
  • Large, bold letters on big 8.5 x 11 inch pages that are easy on the eyes
  • Words run forward and diagonally only, never backwards
  • One puzzle per page, with every answer at the back

A thoughtful stocking stuffer or Secret Santa gift for grandparents, parents, coworkers and puzzle fans.
